# Prepare the change

## Inputs

- Task: requested code change and acceptance criteria.
- Repository: checkout to modify, including its project instructions.
- PR context: destination repository, base branch, and an existing PR URL if continuing work.

Confirm the task and repository are available. Read applicable project instructions and establish authorization to change code and publish a PR. Resolve missing requirements or access before acting.

Return Task, Repository, project instructions, and PR context as explicit inputs for subsequent work.
